verdict_reason: The new copy assertions match both locale files and the copy is used by the view model and template, but two new test titles claim layout and behaviour the assertions cannot prove.

todos.issue: Two new test titles claim more than their copy-equality assertions prove: line 37 'Should name the paging links rather than leave them in English' only asserts copy.pagination / cy.pagination hold Previous/Next and Blaenorol/Nesaf, it cannot show the rendered links are not English (that is view-model.js:60 labels and results.test.js), and 'rather than' narrates a contrast with an earlier state; line 28 'Should name the chosen address above the results' asserts only the selectedAddress string, nothing about placement above the results (that is template.njk:36).
todos.fix: Must: each title states only what its assertions prove, the wording of a copy key in both languages, with no layout or before/after claim. One way: 'Should word the previous and next paging links in both languages' and 'Should word the selected address line in both languages'.
